scopeNote: Observed service rates, accessory and licence prices, subscription prices and quoting structures used by Workstream D to examine pricing, customer TCO and conditional commercial economics; no EMBARCARTE cost, quotation, margin or willingness-to-pay measurement is contained here.

sources.title: Price list — hourly rates, travel by zone and quoting process (valid 1 January – 31 December 2026)
sources.geographicScope: HR (Istria and Gulf of Trieste service area)
sources.limitations: A published rate card of one Croatian marine electrical contractor, VAT-inclusive. It is not a Spanish rate, not an EMBARCARTE cost, not a supplier quotation and not evidence of how many hours a MAREA installation takes.

sources.title: Interfaz — NMEA / NMEA 2000 interface and cabling price list
sources.limitations: Distributor retail listing. VAT basis is not stated on the retrieved page, availability and prices can change, and these are single-purpose interfaces rather than an integrated hub product; they do not establish a MAREA HUB price or cost.

sources.title: B&G Vulcan 7R 7-inch multifunction display listing (ref. 000-14082-001)
sources.limitations: Retailer listing with the price displayed VAT-inclusive and ex-VAT. The page contains an internally inconsistent inclusion statement (it lists a CHIRP sounder while also stating the unit is supplied without chart or transducer), so the price is usable as a category reference but the included scope is LOW confidence.

sources.title: Does a Siren Marine unit require a service plan?
sources.limitations: A US service plan for one competitor's LTE-M monitoring device; the plan bundles connectivity, hosting and support. It is not a MAREA subscription, not a MAREA cost and not a willingness-to-pay measurement.

sources.title: AIS100 — dual-channel AIS receiver with NMEA 0183 output
sources.limitations: The product page establishes scope only: it requires a dedicated VHF/AIS antenna or an antenna splitter sold as an optional accessory. No price was displayed in the retrieved content, and the page cannot establish installation effort or a MAREA AIS cost.

claims.claimText: A published Croatian marine electrical rate card prices systems and electronics integration (instrument networks, panel work, commissioning) at EUR 105 per hour and marine electrical work (diagnostics, wiring, repairs) at EUR 90 per hour, standard hours, VAT-inclusive.
claims.unit: EUR per hour, VAT-inclusive (systems and electronics integration, standard hours)
claims.limitations: One contractor's published rate card in one country; it is not a Spanish rate, not a supplier quotation for EMBARCARTE and not evidence of measured installation hours.

claims.claimText: The same rate card adds 50 percent for out-of-hours and Saturday attendance and 100 percent for Sunday and public holidays, applies a two-hour minimum dockside charge and bills travel at EUR 0.63 per kilometre.
claims.unit: percent surcharge (out-of-hours and Saturday), on a VAT-inclusive rate card
claims.limitations: Service terms of one contractor; they cannot be assumed to apply to a future MAREA installation channel or to any Spanish installer.

claims.claimText: A Spanish distributor lists NMEA 2000 and NMEA 0183 interfaces at EUR 240 (iKonvert), EUR 300 (NavLink2), EUR 318 (ENGINELink) and a basic NMEA 2000 three-device cabling kit at EUR 144, with tax basis not stated on the page.
claims.unit: EUR (iKonvert converter, VAT basis not stated)
claims.limitations: Retail listing of single-purpose interfaces at a point in time; it does not establish an integrated hub price, included software, installation scope or EMBARCARTE cost.

claims.claimText: A Spanish retailer displays a B&G Vulcan 7R 7-inch multifunction display at EUR 685.57 VAT-inclusive (EUR 566.58 excluding VAT), while the same page both lists a CHIRP sounder and states that the unit is supplied without chart or transducer.
claims.limitations: The displayed price is accountable but the included scope is contradictory on the page; the listing neither includes chart data nor establishes a MAREA DISPLAY price, cost or specification.

claims.claimText: The same retailer lists chart/data cards separately: a Navionics+ Western Europe card at EUR 145.10 VAT-inclusive and a C-MAP REVEAL EW-227 card at EUR 214.67 VAT-inclusive, plus NMEA 2000 starter kits at EUR 94.68 and EUR 98.72.
claims.unit: EUR, VAT-inclusive (Navionics+ Western Europe chart card)
claims.limitations: A card purchase is not the same entitlement as an annual subscription or an official ENC licence; the prices do not establish MAREA chart rights, chart costs or a NAV price.

claims.claimText: Observed marine hardware reference points at the same Spanish retailer include a B&G WS310 wind sensor at EUR 489.95 VAT-inclusive, a Simrad NAIS-500 Class B AIS transponder at EUR 812.62 and an Icom MA510TR AIS transponder at EUR 988.07.
claims.limitations: These are transponders and instrument sensors, not a receive-only AIS receiver or a MAREA SENSE module; scope, certification, installation labour and tax treatment are not comparable line for line.

claims.claimText: Siren Marine states that a service plan is required for its monitoring device to communicate over 4/5G LTE-M, priced at USD 225 per year or USD 22 per month, with a USD 150 seasonal plan for April to October.
claims.unit: USD per year (monitoring service plan including LTE-M connectivity)
claims.limitations: A US competitor's plan that bundles connectivity, hosting and support; it is not a MAREA subscription price, not a MAREA connectivity cost and not evidence of what a MAREA customer would pay.

claims.claimText: The AIS100 receiver product page states that the unit requires a dedicated VHF/AIS antenna or an antenna splitter purchased as an optional accessory, and the retrieved page displays no price.
claims.unit: scope requirement (antenna or splitter required; no price displayed)
claims.limitations: An inclusion statement about a competitor's receiver; it establishes that an antenna or splitter is a separately purchasable item, not the price of that item or its requirement on a MAREA AIS configuration.

claims.claimText: The Croatian contractor's price list states that installations and rebuilds are quoted per vessel after a paid assessment, in a written quote with a fixed labour price, itemised hardware and a schedule, with 50 percent due on approval and 50 percent on commissioning sign-off.
claims.unit: percent payment on approval (second 50 percent on commissioning sign-off)
claims.limitations: One contractor's commercial process; it illustrates a quotation and milestone structure and does not establish a MAREA payment policy or contract term.

claims.claimText: The same price list bills major hardware separately at cost plus margin or owner-supplied, and states that owner-supplied equipment is installed but not warranted, while the installation itself is warranted.
claims.unit: warranty scope split (installation warranted, owner-supplied hardware not warranted)
claims.limitations: A single contractor's warranty boundary; it shows that warranty scope must be split by supply route and does not establish a MAREA warranty term or reserve.
